title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery: Agency Recovery Fee on Involuntary Recoveries
content:
Recovery Department entry for the agency recovery fee charged on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case whose vehicle a licensed recovery agency took back involuntarily.

## Rule

For a case whose recovery method is involuntary recovery, the agency recovery fee replaces the plain class involuntary repossession fee and is figured as this rule sets out; the voluntary surrender fee is figured by its own surrender fee rule, and the impound release fees and every other expense on the class schedule are charged exactly as the expense schedule states.

| Recovery method on the case | Fee this entry governs |
|---|---|
| Involuntary recovery | the agency recovery fee |
| Voluntary surrender | not this fee (the surrender fee rule governs) |
| Impound release | not this fee (the expense schedule governs the impound release fees) |

## Charging the fee in the system

The fee is booked with the agent-side tool `post_agency_recovery_fee_54cbecc0`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.

**Capability.** One call records one new expense of kind involuntary repossession fee on the case, dated today, and raises the case's posted recovery expenses outstanding by the same amount; the borrower and the agent can then see the new expense in the case activity and the higher outstanding figure on the case.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `recovery_case_id` | the reference number of the repossession case the fee is charged to, as returned by the repossession case lookup for this borrower's contract | case identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the agency recovery fee being charged | US dollars, a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation string naming the new case activity reference number (a text identifier that begins with "rfee_"), the case reference number, the fee charged in USD with 2 decimal places, the posting date in YYYY-MM-DD form and the case's new recovery expenses outstanding in USD with 2 decimal places. A string that begins with "Recovery fee posted" means the expense was recorded.

## Q&A on the tool contract

- *What date does the expense carry?* The posting date is the day of the call.
- *Does the tool work the fee out?* No. It records the amount passed in `amount_usd`.
